verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developers.cloudflare.com, the docs site that hosts the Sandbox documentation, so an agent can be pointed at it. It is a Cloudflare-wide index, though, and the per-page markdown probe for the Sandbox get-started page returned 404. That limits agent-oriented access to Sandbox-specific docs. Missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt covers Sandbox pages, working per-page markdown docs, Sandbox-specific agent-oriented docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt # Cloudflare Developer Documentation
